subject: Commercial terms & technical guidance — batching / caching and quantization recommendations for GlintAI
messages:
From: Gloria Santos <gloria@glintai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Park <alicia.procurement@glintai.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick question on credits, quantization and expected latency

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran the sample traces your team shared and have a few commercial/technical questions before we move to procurement:

- For our intermittent burst pattern (50 req/s for 10–20s every 5 minutes), how does the Optimize credits bundling work with batching? Do credits count per token generated or per request when batching is enabled?
- We’re evaluating aggressive int8 quantization; if we go to your recommended quantized model, what quality regressions should we expect and do you have benchmarks on GLUE-style tasks or representative in-house evals?
- Pricing: can you provide a firm 12-month price for a bundle that includes 200M generation tokens/month + 100k embedding units/month, plus the Optimize advisory pack (one-time)?

We’re trying to finalize numbers for our Q4 procurement cycle. If possible, can you share a simple mutual action plan and any SOC2 artifacts we can send to our security team?

Appreciate it —
Gloria
VP Product, GlintAI

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Gloria Santos <gloria@glintai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick question on credits, quantization and expected latency

Gloria —

Great questions; short answers up front and then attached a concise pricing worksheet + MAP:

1) Credits counting: billing is per-token for generation/embedding. When batching is active we still meter tokens — the benefit of batching is lower per-token latency and cost due to amortized kernel overhead, but your credit units will be consumed by the actual generated tokens. Our Optimize layer can apply prefix/KV caching so repeat prefixes don’t re-bill.

2) Quantization: our recommended quantized path (8-bit with selective fp16 kernels on attention) typically shows <2% quality delta on our conversational evals, and ~3–4% on some synthetic NLU tasks. We’ll run your eval set as part of the advisory pack to quantify impact. If you need stricter quality SLOs, we can scope a mixed-precision profile where key layers stay fp16.

3) Pricing: attaching a 12-month line-item proposal in the sheet. Short version: 200M gen tokens + 100k embeddings + one Optimize advisory engagement (3 consult days, eval runs, quantization tuning) — list price $78k/mo with recommended discounts below. I’ve also sketched two bundling options in the sheet: credits-only vs. credits+Optimize.

Attachments: Optimize_Toolkit_Pricing_Sheet_v2.xlsx; Mutual_Action_Plan_GlintAI.docx; SOC2-summary-2026.pdf

Next steps: can we set up a 30-minute sync Thurs to review the MAP and the eval plan? If Alicia is on procurement, looping her in will help get timelines aligned.

—Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: GlintAI pricing ask — discount cadence and approval request

Team —

GlintAI is asking for a 12-month firm price for 200M gen / 100k embed + Optimize advisory. They’re sensitive to latency for bursts. My proposed approach:

- Commercial: Offer a 20% volume discount for the 12-month commit if they take credits+Optimize bundle. If they want credits-only, 12% discount. Include a clause for true-up if usage exceeds 20% month-over-month on average.
- Technical concessions: Include 2 free advisory days to run their eval set and a follow-on quantization tuning run (we’ll bill additional days at standard consulting rates).
- SLA/Docs: Provide SOC2 summary (attached) and a short MAP with milestones (eval, procurement sign, pilot, roll).

Questions: 20% for credits+Optimize seems aggressive — Karthik/hannah, can you confirm that the margin math works if we price list at $78k/mo and give 20%? If not, what’s the floor? I’d rather get fast approval than drag this.

Thanks —
Ben
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 10:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: GlintAI pricing ask — discount cadence and approval request

Ben —

I ran the numbers. Floor for credits+Optimize (given expected infra and support load): 15% on that list price; margin below that starts to require a committed 18-month minimum or an uplift on advisory day rates. For credits-only the floor is 8–10% depending on expected tail usage (burst profile increases kernel costs).

Recommendation: Offer 15% conditional on a 12-month commit plus a 6-week pilot milestone that gates the advisory free days. Keep the true-up clause but add a soft cap on sustained bursts (e.g., sustained >80 req/s over 15 minutes will require a re-eval of the throughput profile).

I’ll prepare an approved concession note you can attach.

—Karthik
Head of Pricing & Platform Economics
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Gloria Santos <gloria@glintai.com>, Alicia Park <alicia.procurement@glintai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Nov 2026 17:45:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal and MAP — 12-month credits+advisory bundle

Gloria / Alicia —

Thanks for the patience while we aligned internally. Attached is a concise proposal and MAP. Highlights:

- Commercial: 12-month commit for 200M generation tokens + 100k embeddings + Optimize advisory (includes eval runs + quantization tuning). Approved concession: 15% off the list price ($78k/mo list => $66.3k/mo). Annual prepay option available at an additional 3% discount.
- Technical: We’ll run your eval set in week 1 of the MAP, produce a quantization impact report by week 3, and deliver tuned kernels/profiles in week 6. If we see >4% quality regression on your core prompts we’ll recommend a mixed-precision fallback and scope remediation work.
- Ops: SOC2 summary and required artifacts attached. Pilot milestone defined (6 weeks) with usage true-up clause after 30 days of production traffic consistent exceedance.

Attachments: Optimize_Toolkit_Pricing_Sheet_v2.xlsx; Mutual_Action_Plan_GlintAI.docx; SOC2-summary-2026.pdf

If that looks good I can push an SOW and a PO-ready sheet to Alicia. Can we target signature by 11/13 to hit your Q4 procurement window?

Cheers —
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
